150410101.text: Brave adventurers, welcome to Villa Guiztli! You're just in time to witness our annual Pome Night celebration!

150410102.text: Oooh, Paimon likes the sound of that! This place has a great vibe already!

150410105.text: Excuse me, Mr. Nanasian, could you point us in the direction of the town? Is there anything we should bring?

150410106.text: Haha. Just from hearing your question, I can tell I'm speaking to an experienced adventurer.

150410107.text: Just head downhill from here, and you'll soon arrive at the charming town of Villa Guiztli.

150410108.text: As for things to take... You'll need a bold spirit, a heart eager to help others, and a dash of courage to face any challenges that may lie ahead.

150410110.text: Ah, I see you've brought a little companion along with you. Would you mind keeping him in your bag for now, just in case something... unexpected happens?

150410112.text: Okay, all set! Brave challengers, your adventure is about to begin. I wish you all an exciting and unforgettable night ahead!

150410201.text: Whoa, this cave's way bigger than Paimon expected. Looks like a lot of work was put into this town.

150410202.text: Hey, is that... a bounty board?

150410203.text: Let Paimon see... One zero, two zeros, three zeros, four...

150410205.text: Five zeros, six zeros... and there's even a five in front! ... That's five million Mora! Holy— Eek, something's coming!

150410206.text: Esteemed guests, welcome to the beautiful town of Villa Guiztli.

150410207.text: ...Geez, you almost gave Paimon a heart attack!

150410208.text: You must be here for Pome Night. *sigh* I'm sorry to report we won't be celebrating the festival this year.

150410210.text: Not long ago, those Nochtli ruffians ransacked our beautiful town and seized all our gold and treasure.

150410211.text: Even now, their ringleader's still holed up in the town. And worse — not only is he refusing to leave, he expects us to do his bidding.

150410212.text: That's awful! Can't you do something about it?

150410213.text: Well, it's a long story. Anyway, you all made quite the journey to get here. Why don't we head over to the bar for a quick drink?

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow the sheriff to the bar

150410602.text: He disappeared... and no one knows what happened after that.

150410603.text: Some say he took a new name. Others claim he and his companions embarked on a one-way journey to a land as hot as the blazing sun...

150410604.text: If you ever happen to run into him, please let him know how grateful we are for everything he did for us — and also, that we miss him very much.

150410605.text: If we see him, we'll make sure to pass the message along.

150410606.text: Alright, this is the Nochtli gang's hideout. I tailed one of their henchmen once, so I know how to activate the door mechanism, and I can get it open for you.

150410608.text: But this place is under heavy watch. I'll be a sitting duck if I go alone. So, I need some backup.

150410609.text: What do you need us to do?

150410610.text: Knock out anyone who tries to get in my way.

150410611.text: Hehe, now that's a gutsy request.

150410613.text: Heh, I knew Chasca wouldn't need a lot of convincing on that one...

150410614.text: #{NICKNAME}, cover that gun for me, will you?

150410616.text: Man, wish we had backup like this all those times we had to go sneaking around...

subQuests.subQuestName: Help the sheriff activate the mechanism

150410701.text: #Hmph, wow, you won, {NICKNAME}. You're a pretty good shot. Almost seems like you've done this before.

150410702.text: Here, let me teach you how to fire off rapid bursts of bullets. It might come in handy someday.

150410705.text: I got distracted for a split second, and now the Sheriff's been caught...

150410801.text: Too bad, you handled that gun pretty well. Guess you just haven't had enough chances to practice.

150410802.text: Here, let me teach you how to fire off rapid bursts of bullets. It might come in handy someday.

150410805.text: I got distracted for a split second, and now the Sheriff's been caught...

subQuests.subQuestName: Ride the cruise ship and continue your pursuit

150411001.text: Aha, the meddling outsiders have arrived, I see.

150411002.text: Ah! Careful, boss, they got a gun!

150411003.text: A little firepower's got you spooked? Hah, disappointing.

150411004.text: Alright then, show-offs, let's see who's the quicker shot.

150411005.text: There's a ton of smoke over there. What happened?

150411007.text: Whoa, no one outruns Chasca's gun...

150411008.text: Truth is, the leader never planned to fight us. All that talk was just a distraction — a way to create an opening. He was planning to make a run for it all along.

150411009.text: Hmph, acting all tough and then running away like that... What a joke.

150411010.text: Uh-oh... The exit's blocked. Looks like another trap.

150411011.text: What should we do? Is there some kind of mechanism we can use?

150411012.text: Look, there's a bunch of cages down in the canyon. Let's go save those captives first.

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to lift the barrier
Investigate the inside of the cavern

150411502.text: Alright, we've dealt with those monsters, and the Abyssal energy seems to be gone too.

150411504.text: I got a scrape on my arm, but it's nothing. Doesn't even hurt.

150411506.text: Oh, sure... Sorry for making you worry...

150411510.text: Don't you think something weird's going on?

150411511.text: I mean... those Hilichurl Rogues could be actors in costume. But, there shouldn't be any actual Abyssal monsters here, right?

150411512.text: Yeah, there's no way that's meant to be part of the experience.

150411513.text: Plus, the way we came in is blocked now. Everything was fine until the monsters showed up...

150411514.text: Oh no... My bad luck must be back... and I'm dragging everyone down with me...

150411517.text: Abyssal monsters can appear for many reasons. Being attracted by someone or... something is certainly one possibility.

150411518.text: Now isn't the time to blame ourselves. We should focus on identifying any hidden dangers instead.

150411519.text: We still don't know what might have happened outside the cave.

150411520.text: You're right. Okay, I'll take the lead and scout ahead!

150411521.text: Hah, sorry. I'm gonna have to call dibs on that one.

150411522.text: We should do this the Natlan way. As the most mobile member of the team, leave the scouting to me. It happens to be a Flower-Feather Clan specialty.

150411523.text: Alright, I'll go check on the situation outside. See you soon.

150411526.text: Wait a sec, we're not ready y—

150411528.text: Heh, she sure is a fast flyer. I can't even see her anymore...

150411529.text: Well at least there's a way out now... Wait, what are you looking at?

150411531.text: The Tecpatl's Flintblades Adventure Team, Anja, Macani... Huh, Paimon doesn't recognize any of those names.

subQuests.subQuestName: Leave the cavern and ride the cruise ship again
Bring down "El Capoctus Joquiratto"'s hot air balloon
Go to where the hot air balloon crashed on top of the mountain

150412002.text: Surrender now, and maybe, just maybe, I'll let him live.

150412003.text: Whew, that was one big hill... Paimon's hair is dry already. Wait, that's... Chasca!

150412005.text: And Nana... Uh, Paimon forgot the rest...

150412007.text: I'll say it one last time — if you want him to live, drop your weapons and surrender!

150412008.text: You shoot or try any other funny business, and I'll throw him right off this cliff.

150412009.text: Please... I'm begging you, don't do this...

150412011.text: That's weird... What's Chasca waiting for?

150412014.text: Huh? You mean like... someone replaced the actor?

150412015.text: If we factor in those Abyssal monsters that came out of nowhere, does that mean this is...

150412017.text: Enough! Even my patience has its limits.

150412018.text: Back off now, all of you! Get away from the cliff!

150412019.text: Run, adventurers, run! Leave the town, leave me to my fate!

150412025.text: Thank you, brave adventurers! You saved Villa Guiztli, and you saved me too!

150412028.text: El Capoctus Joquiratto... was played by a bunch of Asha!?

150412029.text: Congratulations, everyone! You bravely chose the path of justice and vanquished the wicked El Capoctus Joquiratto!

150412031.text: Okay, okay, hold on... So, it wasn't real? We all freaked out for nothing?

150412032.text: I mean, there was cause for concern — I was worried, too.

150412033.text: Even though I didn't see any other Abyssal monsters on the way here, I didn't let my guard down.

150412034.text: Under normal circumstances, I would've taken the shot without hesitation. With Soulsniper on my side, I'm confident I could get to the hostage no problem, even if the hostile tried to harm them.

150412035.text: But this time, it seemed like our enemy was tainted by the Abyss, so we couldn't afford to take any chances. We had to factor in the worst-case scenario.

150412036.text: #So, the only option was for {NICKNAME} and I to strike at the same time, ensuring we took down the villain and rescued the hostage in one fell swoop.

150412037.text: Wow, good thing you two got a chance to work on your teamwork against those lackeys earlier...

150412038.text: In hindsight, it's clear the only place where things went wrong was that cave.

150412039.text: So, since we cleared out those monsters already, we're in the clear?

150412041.text: Sorry, I don't follow. By "cave," you're not referring to somewhere inside one of our amusement facilities, are you...?

150412042.text: Yeah, we came across an adventurer camp inside the cave. Y'know, near the spot where the Sheriff snuffs it... Oh, um, sorry. That came out a little harsh...

150412043.text: But... There's no cave or camp anywhere near there...

150412044.text: You sure it wasn't your eyes playing tricks on you?

150412045.text: No, definitely not. First, we were ambushed by monsters, then we even read through the adventurer's notes. There's no way it was just an illusion.

150412046.text: Oh, we even have evidence! The scratch on my arm is still there! Haha, guess there was a silver lining to getting hurt, after all.

150412048.text: Villa Guiztli's meant to be a fully immersive experience. There's no way we'd leave in design flaws that didn't fit the theme...

150412050.text: So, is something else going on here, then? Paimon's getting a bad feeling all of a sudden...

subQuests.subQuestName: Ride the cruise ship and proceed onward

150412301.text: Ahh, I feel a bit more relaxed now.

150412302.text: Yeah. Honestly, it's our fault for messing with stuff that wasn't part of the attraction... Gah, this whole part of the trip's been an emotional rollercoaster.

150412304.text: Wait, are you two still thinking about it?

150412307.text: Yeah... I also think that adventure team's story is real, but I wouldn't be surprised if it took place a long, long time ago.

150412308.text: Like... before this resort was even built.

150412309.text: We're here! You must have been waiting for us to take a group photo, right?

150412311.text: Wait, that reminds Paimon... Wasn't the bounty for getting rid of El Capoctus Joquiratto five... million... Mora!?

150412312.text: Yeah, I don't think we're gonna see a single coin of that. If they actually had to cough up Mora every time he got captured, Villa Guiztli would have gone under a long time ago.

150412313.text: Hehe, exactly! The prize isn't real Mora, just a commemorative Mora-shaped chocolate coin stamped with that number.

150412314.text: But since the chocolates aren't ready yet, I'll give you some Easybreeze Badges you can exchange for other items of your choice.

150412315.text: Oh, well... Paimon would have preferred the chocolate, but other gifts are fine too.

150415001.text: Those guests don't look like they're fooling around... And where'd the cave come from anyway?

150419901.text: *sigh* When oh when will our hero return...

150419902.text: Who is this hero you just mentioned, Sheriff?

150419903.text: Years ago, here in this town of ours, there lived a renowned gunslinger who always stood up for what was right.

150419904.text: Famed for his unmatched courage and unparalleled sense of justice, he came to our aid countless times...

150419905.text: Ugh, what a bunch of rotten scoundrels! If you're gonna talk the talk, at least have the courage to back it up!

150419906.text: Let's check out that cave that got blown open. Maybe we'll find a clue to help us escape?

150419916.text: El Capoctus Joquiratto's making a run for the cliffs — we can't let him get away!

150419917.text: You know what? At the end of the day, we still did a good thing! We kept the town safe!

150419918.text: So, if any more monsters show up... we'll just clear 'em out, like we always do!

150419919.text: You know what? At the end of the day, we still did a good thing! We kept the town safe!

150419920.text: So, if any more monsters show up... we'll just clear 'em out, like we always do!
